foundational_backlog.title: PostgreSQL handleRetireMasterKEK FORCE RLS Visibility Hazard & TANPOPO_MASTER_KEY_PREVIOUS Key-ID Mismatch
foundational_backlog.description: Static inspection indicates handleRetireMasterKEK runs SELECT COUNT(*) FROM org_encryption_keys WHERE kek_key_id = ? inside withOperatorReadTx (current_org_id=''). Because org_encryption_keys enforces FORCE RLS without an operator read clause, PostgreSQL is expected to return 0 even when active tenant DEKs remain wrapped under that KEK, risking premature bypass of 409 org_deks_not_rewrapped. Additionally, serve.go:359 assigns synthetic ID 'kek_prev_0' to TANPOPO_MASTER_KEY_PREVIOUS entries (mismatching AAD-bound original KEK IDs) and RetireKEK scrubs RAM only on the local Control-Plane node.
foundational_backlog.required_action: 1) Write a non-destructive multi-org PostgreSQL 16 integration test reproducing handleRetireMasterKEK with wrapped org_encryption_keys rows under FORCE RLS. 2) Remediate via a narrowly scoped RLS-safe KEK reference count + cluster-wide KEY_RETIRE epoch scrub + <id>=<base64> previous-key parsing before production PostgreSQL KEK retirement is used.
